chrome.soundTitle: Bell at the open and close, a till for a closed winner, a buzzer for a closed loser. Sound is on by default; a browser will not let it play until you have clicked somewhere in the page.
chrome.marketTitleOpen: The broker's clock said the session was open at {{at}}
chrome.marketTitleClosed: The broker's clock said the session was closed at {{at}}
chrome.marketTitleUnknown: No scheduled run has recorded a session boundary yet
chrome.busyTitle: The agent is mid-cycle. This is read from the last record it wrote, so it clears itself if the process stops.
chrome.marketTitleBoundary: Nothing recorded this crossing — the agent was not running — but the broker had already published it for {{crossed}}, and that time has passed. Derived from Alpaca's own clock, not from a calendar kept here.
chrome.marketTitleLastSeen: Last seen at {{at}}, and nothing has written to the journal since. There is no published boundary to work from either, so this is the last state observed rather than the state now.

halt.detail: {{reason}} — entries are blocked until this is cleared at the CLI. Exits are not: they never are.

console.none: No proposal has been gated yet — most cycles end in a considered pass, and the gates only see a proposal.
console.noOverride: There is no override. A rejected proposal is not submitted, and the limits it failed can only change in the environment.
console.confidenceNote: — journalled, not consulted by any gate.

journal.title: RUN JOURNAL
journal.note: Every proposal the model made is here, approved or not. Rejections are records, not errors — a gate that never fires is a gate that was never load-bearing.

gates.title: GATE CHAIN
gates.note: Every gate runs on every proposal — none of them short-circuits, so the counts above are out of all {{seen}}. The order is the order they are evaluated in, and it comes from the server rather than from this page: adding a gate changes this list on the next push.
gates.readOnly: Nothing here is a control, by design. Limits live in .env, so changing one is a diff someone can review — a field in a dashboard that moves a risk limit leaves no such trace. The socket this panel listens on is never read from at all.

rail.limitsNote: Set from the environment at startup. Not editable here, and never by the model.

equity.title: EQUITY
equity.none: No equity readings yet — the curve is written one point per scan cycle.
equity.one: One reading so far. A line needs two.

book.title: THE BOOK
book.note: Click a structure to chart it against the levels its exit policy acts on. A price shown here is the fill where one has been confirmed, and the submitted limit where it has not. P&L is realized on a closed row and marked-to-market on an open one.
book.patternsTitle: Confirmed chart patterns on {{underlying}}. Shown only — the exit policy does not read them.

chart.noHistory: No price history for these contracts. The levels below are still exact — they come from the ledger and the exit policy, not from the tape.
chart.noEntry: No entry price recorded, so there is nothing to measure a target or a stop from.
chart.legend: target = {{tp}}% of the credit taken · stop = {{sl}}% of it
chart.credit: credit structure — the mark rises toward zero as it wins
chart.debit: debit structure — the mark rises as it wins
chart.note: Entry, target and stop come from the same function the exit policy acts on, so this picture cannot disagree with what the agent will actually do.
chart.forceClose: force-close at {{dte}} DTE regardless of price
chart.unreachableNote: This structure was opened for a debit, so the most it can lose is the premium paid. A stop set above 100% of that cannot print — the line sits at zero, which is where the position becomes worthless.
chart.seriesNote: The line is hourly bars; NOW is a live quote when the broker answers.
chart.forming: the hollow candle is still forming — its close is the live mark
chart.fitTitle: Add the stop to the scale. It sits far from the price, so the candles compress.
chart.offscreen: {{name}} is off the chart at {{value}} — FIT STOP to see it
chart.timeframeTitle: Bar size. Finer is not always denser for a spread — both legs must print in the same bar for the net to exist.
chart.legsNote: Fill prices come from the opening order's own legs, so they belong to this structure — the broker nets a shared contract across every structure holding it. The P&L column adds up to the position's, exactly.
chart.legsPending: This position was opened before per-leg fills were recorded. The agent asks the broker for them once, on its next cycle.

committee.title: COMMITTEE
committee.meta: {{count}} session(s) — catalyst, then bull and bear in parallel, then a judge
committee.empty: No committee has sat yet. Sessions appear here once the agent scans with COMMITTEE on.
committee.reflectionEmpty: nothing closed on this underlying yet
committee.note: The committee cannot approve anything. Whichever path built a proposal, it meets the same sixteen gates.
committee.costNote: Only the judge picks a structure; the other three feed it, and run a tier below.

scoreboard.title: THE RUN
scoreboard.drawdownNote: over {{samples}} scan samples — scan resolution, not tick
scoreboard.turnsNote: A pass is a considered decline, counted separately.
scoreboard.unrealizedNote: Priced at the agent's last mark, not live.

news.label: TAPE
news.title: Headlines the catalyst read this cycle, newest first. Untrusted publisher text — it reaches the model inside an explicit fence and nothing downstream treats it as an instruction. Hover to pause.
